sites.first_line: // Rename Page 1 via double-click inline input (FR-9, AC-6)
sites.rule: Use data-testid="page-rename-input", re-query [data-testid="page-tab-${DEFAULT_PAGE_ID}"] before the second doubleClick, click [data-testid="page-move-left-${page2Id}"], and call api!.reorderPages(0, 1).

tests.name: hides PageBar by default and renders it when UIOptions.canvasActions.pages is true
tests.given: <Excalidraw /> rendered with default props vs UIOptions={{ canvasActions: { pages: true } }} and viewModeEnabled
tests.expect: page-bar is absent by default, present with page-bar-add when UIOptions.canvasActions.pages is true, and hides mutation buttons in viewModeEnabled

tests.name: adds, switches, renames, reorders, and deletes pages while preserving per-page viewport and isolating elements
tests.given: an Excalidraw instance with UIOptions={{ canvasActions: { pages: true } }} and elements on Page 1 and Page 2
tests.expect: each page retains its own elements and scrollX/scrollY/zoom, empty rename is rejected, actionSelectAll only selects active-page elements, and deleting the last page is prevented

tests.name: scopes undo/redo to each page without switching pages or recording page switches
tests.given: elements created on Page 1, Page 2 added and switched to, undo/redo executed on Page 2, and then switched back to Page 1
tests.expect: adding and switching to Page 2 starts Page 2 with an empty undo stack, undo on Page 2 never switches pages or mutates Page 1's elements, undo on Page 2 only reverts Page 2 edits, and switching back to Page 1 allows undoing Page 1's element edits

tests.name: restores legacy single-page scenes, serializes all pages to JSON, and scopes visual exports via exportScene to the active page
tests.given: legacy scene data without pages/pageId and a multi-page scene exported via serializeAsJSON, exportScene, and exportToClipboard
tests.expect: legacy data normalizes to Page 1, serializeAsJSON includes all pages and elements, and exportScene ('svg' and 'canvas') and exportToClipboard render only active-page elements while embedding all pages when embedScene is true

tests.name: searches across all pages, reconciles remote pages, and filters remote collaborator cursors by pageId
tests.given: text elements across Page 1 and Page 2, remote pages and elements passed to reconcilePages, and collaborators with different pageIds
tests.expect: SearchMenu lists matches from both pages and switches activePageId on selection, and reconcilePages keeps local pages that still have non-deleted elements on them (AC-12)
